parameters.content:
## Create a local forecast with a ranked daytime planning window

### How it works
Resolve one city, validate fresh current and hourly data, and rank remaining three-hour daytime windows by rain probability and wind. Branch to a qualifying window or a no-window notice, then add that planning card to the local forecast and three-day outlook. A separate recovery log skips completed keys and resumes accepted jobs. Review the video and CSV before sharing.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; select it on all Zvid nodes.
3. Connect Google Sheets and select the **Weather Briefings** log tab. Create RenderKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, PlanJson, VideoUrl and CompletedAt headers; optional delivery also needs DeliveryStatus.
4. Configure cityName, countryCode and admin1 for an unambiguous location; rain and wind thresholds. See the [source contract and migration guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/daily-weather-video.md).
5. **dryRun=false spends credits.** true returns JSON and a quote only. Set maxCreditsPerVideo, then test manually before enabling the schedule.
6. Avoid overlapping executions. Inspect submitting, failed or uncertain jobs before resetting any log row.

### Customization
Adjust branding and the domain rules in **Set the city and outdoor planning thresholds**. Watch downloads time out after 30 seconds; the saved URL remains available.

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose source rules and schedule

Complete the overview setup and source contract. Run one execution at a time. Use the manual trigger before enabling the schedule.

nodes.name: 2. Check the real source and plan the output

parameters.content:
## 2. Check the real source and plan the output

Require one city and fresh forecast data. Evaluate future daytime hours and rank contiguous three-hour windows by rain probability and wind.

nodes.name: 3. Recover accepted work before a new render

parameters.content:
## 3. Recover accepted work before a new render

Saved jobs follow the upper route using their original review context. New work continues through optional media and the domain design.

nodes.name: 4. Check optional background music

parameters.content:
## 4. Check optional background music

A failed or oversized music file is skipped. Empty musicUrl continues without an external request. This check preserves the selected source plan.

nodes.name: 5. Compose the forecast and planning advice

parameters.content:
## 5. Compose the forecast and planning advice

Choose a qualifying daytime planning window or explain why none meets the thresholds. Add the checked current conditions and forecast to the video.

nodes.name: 6. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

parameters.content:
## 6. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

dryRun=true returns the source plan, design JSON and quote. It performs no log writes, editor draft creation, render, or delivery.

nodes.name: 7. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

parameters.content:
## 7. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

Save the key and accepted job ID. Retry explicit capacity rejections up to three attempts, respecting the server delay and a 30-second minimum. Uncertain submissions require inspection. Sheets is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 8. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

parameters.content:
## 8. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

Poll the saved job within the deadline. Keep failed, timed-out and uncertain job IDs for inspection. Completed keys are skipped on later runs.

nodes.name: 9. Review the video and source-specific handoff

parameters.content:
## 9. Review the video and source-specific handoff

Completed renders reach Watch video → Binary → data → View. A failed render stops with its actual reason after saving the tracking row. Download the review CSV and check source facts before sharing.
